# 5 teams: the bracket of 8 gives byes to seeds 1, 2, 3 (D11); 1 and 2 can only meet in the final.
teams 5
stage knockout third_place
expect ready 4-5 2-3
expect next 4-5
play 4-5 5
expect ready 1-5 2-3
expect next 2-3 after 4-5          # 5 just played
play 2-3 3 10:9
play 1-5 1
expect ready 1-3 2-5               # the final and the 3rd place game (semi-final losers): any order
play 2-5 2
play 1-3 3
expect finished
expect placements 1:3 2:1 3:2
